correctness.rationale: For real H dimension d>=2, the rank-one singular-value polynomial has trace 2+2tc+t^2, determinant (1+tc)^2 and larger singular value Psi_t(c); strict monotonicity reduces the norm minimax to eta_G. For irreducible real orthogonal G, averaging gu and gu tensor gu gives mean zero and second moment 1/d. Averaging (Z+1)(M-Z)>=0 gives M>=1/d; equality forces all correlations -1 or 1/d and, by transitive orbit averaging, exactly d+1 pairwise -1/d vectors, hence a simplex and the specified minimizing v. Standard S_{d+1} orbit attains it. Type B rearrangement and nested-prefix estimate show eta=1/sqrt(d), with axis-flat equality; cyclic/dihedral rotation m orbit gives cos(pi/m). The restricted rank-one numerical radius is (1+eta)/2, not an unrestricted index. Degenerate collinear endpoints and t>2 handled by exact Psi formula. The first two family results are already in a 2026-10-18 published record; proof still correct.

originality.rationale: PASS: Main new assertion is a universal finite-irreducible-group minimax lower bound with sharp regular-simplex orbit rigidity and the S_{d+1} standard-action case. Two prominently listed group-family profiles (all signed permutations, all planar cyclic/dihedral groups), their extremizers and planar asymptotics ARE covered by the earlier 2026-10-18 published Resultary theorem and must not be described as new; prior exact rank-one singular-value reduction is also covered. Their repetition does not logically imply the universal irreducible-action simplex criterion, and the final claim contains this nontrivial uncaptured theorem. Publication-priority risk remains for an equivalent general spherical-covering-frame theorem.
